tools.name: lookup_field
tools.description: Look up the crop history for a US agricultural field by its CropHist field ID. Returns year-by-year crop history (2008-2024) with rotation analysis. Field IDs are numeric strings found via the CropHist map at crophist.com.

tools.name: find_field
tools.description: Find the agricultural field at a given latitude/longitude and return its crop history. Coordinates must be within the continental US. Returns 2008-2024 history with rotation analysis.

tools.name: search_location
tools.description: Search for a US location by name (city, county, address, landmark) and return the crop history of the nearest agricultural field. Uses geocoding to convert place names to coordinates.

tools.name: check_usage
tools.description: Check API key usage statistics including tier, daily usage, remaining calls, and account info. Requires an API key (pass as ?key= in the MCP server URL).

tools.name: compare_years
tools.description: Compare what was growing on a field between two specific years. Provide either a field_id or lat/lng coordinates, plus two years to compare.

tools.name: crop_stats
tools.description: Get crop area statistics (top crops by area in hectares) for a bounding box or named location. Computed from USDA Cropland Data Layer (CDL) at 30m resolution. Provide either a place_name (geocoded to ~0.5 degree bbox) or explicit bbox coordinates.

tools.name: batch_fields
tools.description: Look up crop history for multiple fields at once (up to 100). Requires a Pro or Enterprise API key. Returns history and rotation analysis for each field.

tools.name: analyze_polygon
tools.description: Analyze crop distribution within a custom GeoJSON polygon. Returns per-year zonal statistics. Requires an Enterprise API key.

tools.name: export_data
tools.description: Get a download URL for bulk crop history data by US state and year. Returns a pre-signed S3 URL valid for 1 hour. Requires an Enterprise API key.
